reasons: Claimed status is compliant-by-absence and the record supports it: no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching language appears in the cited text or elsewhere referenced, so nothing binds the Customer (Corio).

This matches the playbook preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so the absence of any redline or counterparty comment is correct — inserting a duration or carve-out would mean drafting a new restriction against our own client.

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here because they presuppose an existing covenant to narrow; they should not override the substantive absence finding.
The § 14.10 integration clause is a reasonable scope anchor, and the rationale appropriately flags that the incorporated NDA and SOW should be held to the fallback if either contains a non-solicit.
